# Goal

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Goal`](gmeow-Goal.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Goal>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/teleology`](../../slices/teleology.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A described state of affairs that an agent may want, intend, or commit to bring about — the propositional content of the intentional modes, existing by social convention like every description (a [`gmeow:SocialObject`](gmeow-SocialObject.md)). A goal asserts nothing and prescribes nothing by itself: it is satisfied by situations ([`gmeow:satisfiedBy`](../properties/gmeow-satisfiedBy.md)), held by agents ([`gmeow:hasGoal`](../properties/gmeow-hasGoal.md) or the reified modes), and partly defined by its named shadow ([`gmeow:counterGoal`](../properties/gmeow-counterGoal.md)). Whether a given situation satisfies the goal is a vantage-indexed claim ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:SocialObject`](gmeow-SocialObject.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Goal`](gmeow-Goal.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:SocialObject`](gmeow-SocialObject.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

### Goal And Intention

- **Source:** [`slices/core/teleology/examples/goal-and-intention.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/core/teleology/examples/goal-and-intention.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-core-teleology-examples-goal-and-intention)#example-slices-core-teleology-examples-goal-and-intention

```turtle
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Blackcat Informatics® Inc. <paudley@blackcatinformatics.ca>
# SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-4.0
#
# Worked example: goals, intentions, and commitments. GMEOW separates the
# intentional moments gUFO keeps distinct: a gmeow:Goal is the SocialObject an
# agent aims at (gmeow:hasGoal); a gmeow:Intention is an intentional MODE borne by
# an agent that aims at that goal (gmeow:intentionGoal) and MOTIVATES concrete
# action (gmeow:motivates → an Event); a gmeow:Commitment is a relator binding a
# committed agent to a beneficiary. The desire-to / intend-to / commit-to layers
# are not collapsed — each is its own first-class moment.
@prefix gmeow: <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/> .
@prefix ex:    <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/examples/teleology/> .
@prefix rdfs:  <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix xsd:   <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .

# --- The goal: a social object the agent aims at.
ex:degreeGoal a gmeow:Goal ; rdfs:label "Earn a master's degree"@en .
```

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:SocialObject`](gmeow-SocialObject.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name the propositional content an agent may want, intend, or commit to — the shared target that the intentional modes and the flat [`gmeow:hasGoal`](../properties/gmeow-hasGoal.md) point at, and the thing a situation can satisfy.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the agent's holding of the goal (that is [`gmeow:hasGoal`](../properties/gmeow-hasGoal.md) or a [`Desire`](gmeow-Desire.md)/Intention/Commitment) and for prescriptive force — a [`Goal`](gmeow-Goal.md) prescribes nothing; obligatory conduct arrives via the norms extension, never on the [`Goal`](gmeow-Goal.md) itself.

### How to use

- Mint one [`Goal`](gmeow-Goal.md) individual and share it across every agent and mode aiming at it; attach [`gmeow:counterGoal`](../properties/gmeow-counterGoal.md) for constitutive opposition and [`gmeow:satisfiedBy`](../properties/gmeow-satisfiedBy.md) for achieving situations, recording disputed satisfaction as coexisting [`gmeow:accordingTo`](../properties/gmeow-accordingTo.md) claims rather than a global verdict.

### Examples

- ex:reachOrbit a [`gmeow:Goal`](gmeow-Goal.md); [`gmeow:counterGoal`](../properties/gmeow-counterGoal.md) ex:scrubLaunch; [`gmeow:satisfiedBy`](../properties/gmeow-satisfiedBy.md) ex:firstStableOrbit.
